2. Now, Government Circular No. Finance-2025 / Q. 44 / Finance-3, D. As per the 07.04.2025 as well as the demand of the training centre concerned, the Joint Training Centre, Gargoti, District Kolhapur, has been provided with 31-Auxiliary Grants-in-Aid (Non-Payment) amounting to Rs. 1,88,200 - (Rupees One Lakh AANA Thousand Two Hundred Only) The Government is approving the disbursement of the fund as the sixth instalment.

3. Government Circular No. Training-1198 / Q. No. 581/61, No. 23rd September, 1998 and Government Circular, Department of Rural Development and Water Conservation No. Training 2000 / Q. 859/44, D. The Additional Commissioner (Aastha), Pune Division, Pune, in pursuance of the instructions issued under 12th June 2001, should expeditiously take action regarding payment of monthly subsidy to the training centre. Also the Centre should spend as per the condition in paragraph number 12 of the Government Decision of Reference No. 1.

The Office of the Additional Commissioner (Aastha), Divisional Commissioner concerned shall be responsible for the distribution of the funds and for the strict implementation of the same for which the funds have been sanctioned. Care should also be taken to submit a certificate of utilization of the fund immediately.

5. This cost is "Demand No. L3,2515, Other Rural Development Programme 31 - Subsidiary Grants (Non-Payment) (25150026) "to be spent under headings and it should be met from the provision made under headings this year. It should also be harmonized to ensure that the expenditure falls under the same index and the Divisional Commissioner should report it to the government every month. This will be handled by the Controller of Accounts Head and the Additional Commissioner (Establishment) concerned as the Drawing and Disbursing Officer.

6. The Divisional Commissioner's Office while disbursing the grant to the training centre shall ensure that the amount required is made available to them by verifying the actual amount of grant required on salary / non-salary basis. Care should be taken to ensure that no more than the above mentioned grants are disbursed. Also, the training centre should give prior intimation to the concerned Commissioner's office as to how much subsidy is required per month for salary / non-payment. Accordingly, the Commissioner's Office shall disburse the grant for salary / non-salary. The principal of the centre concerned will be solely responsible for the necessary grants, if they are not given prior notice.

With this grant, the Accountant General, (Accounts) Maharashtra-I Mumbai and / or Accountant General, Maharashtra-II Nagpur shall be empowered to examine the separate accounts and books of expenditure made by the respective Training Centre and shall be assisted / facilitated by the respective Training Centre / Institutions so as to enable them to carry out their work properly.
